name: Structural Health Monitoring
description: Introduction to Structural Health Monitoring (SHM); Types of structural damage and degradation mechanisms; Sensing technologies and sensor networks (strain gauges, accelerometers, fiber optics, piezoelectrics); Data acquisition and signal processing (filtering, sampling, frequency analysis); Vibration-based SHM (modal analysis, frequency response); Wave propagation-based methods (ultrasonics, acoustic emission); Advanced sensing technologies (fiber Bragg gratings, smart materials); Feature extraction and data analytics for SHM; Data-driven and physics-driven techniques for damage detection and localization; SHM system integration and deployment strategies.
